device: arm64 Apple M4 Max (16 hardware threads)

model_config.host_context: Apple M4 Max laptop, macOS, release build of the measured commit (origin/main after #346 plus the E12-14 claim commit; the admission PR changes no Rust). One run of each process, no repeats: the model committed once (P = 8, T = 64), then proofs 0 and 1 against it, both verified with --expect-model, then proof 1 pinned to another model digest (refused). Other agents' builds and tests shared the host; each timed step waited for a 1-minute load average below 1.5 and started at 1.44 (commit), 1.29 (prove) and 1.42 (verify), so the times carry that noise. The same window at the E12-27 head 1b0c94e proved in 364 s in an earlier single run. BSD /usr/bin/time -l.

model.cqis: int8 matrices, dynamic rows, random small codes

note: RFC-0026 development tier (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural. dev-zk profile (RFC-0013 A5, RFC-0026 A9 profile byte 1), admitted at the development tier; zero knowledge is conditional and computational (seed-derived masks). The weights and the 1-D records (RFC-0013 A7) are committed once by commit-model as one published commitment for P proofs (A6), recorded as stage model_commitment_once and not part of the prove time. Prover time is the prove-dev --zk process wall time of proof 0: Artifact decode, executor capture, plain check and proof (witness_recompute_ns 0). Verifier time is verify-dev with --expect-model; proof 1 against the same commitment also verifies. The control is verify-dev of proof 1 pinned to another model digest. One run of each process, no repeats: single-run wall times on a laptop. CPU only, no GPU. Peak RSS is the BSD /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size. Not a cost-model fit input.
